answer_1.quote: Unlike the extractive QA setting in ROBUSTQA and NQ, we adopt generative QA as it is most compatible with the generative nature of the leading LLMs with the flexibility to produce free-form answers.

answer_3.quote: we adopt model-based evaluators for scalable evaluation of LLMs on the entire LFRQA test set.

answer_4.quote: We present a query and a pair of answers (one from LFRQA and one from an LLM), to human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are instructed to rate preferences based on three aspects: helpfulness, truthfulness, and completeness, with truthfulness as the primary criterion.
